delta_expectations.reason: Adds precise suspected-case classification; no independently proven increase in total cases.

ambiguity_notes: Publication-order simulation retains unknown authentic availability. New publisher/headline is not a new outbreak.

decisions.decision: Allow precise case-status refinement; no required new patients/deaths or correction.
